boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Puget Sound, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning the campus, finding practical hubs, and sampling its public arts and recreation spaces.

cards.entity_name: University of Puget Sound Interactive Campus Map
cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Plan your route before heading out
cards.notes: Open the university’s interactive map, search the stops you want, and use its building, parking, and accessibility details to orient your walk.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for finding campus destinations and accessibility information.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound describes its interactive map as a guide with detailed information on buildings, spaces, parking, and accessibility.
cards.source_title: Campus Map & Directions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Use the online map to confirm the current route and building access before leaving.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Wheelock
cards.subtitle: Campus cocurricular hub
cards.notes: Stop at Wheelock to see the Information Center and locate student organizations, campus media, dining, the bookstore, and student-support offices.
cards.short_summary: A central building that brings together campus services, organizations, and eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: The university calls Wheelock Student Center the cocurricular hub and lists ASUPS, student media, eateries, the bookstore, and support services there.
cards.access_notes: Check the campus map and building signage for current access and office availability.

cards.title: Have a daytime meal at The Diner
cards.subtitle: Wheelock Student Center
cards.notes: Use a meal swipe or dining funds if you have them, then take a few minutes to notice where the dining areas and nearby campus services are.
cards.short_summary: The university’s primary dining location inside Wheelock Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says The Diner is in Wheelock Student Center and that meal swipes may be redeemed there.
cards.source_title: The Diner | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Normal weekend hours listed by Dining & Event Services are 8 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; confirm updates before going.

cards.title: Find Collins Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library
cards.notes: Walk through the library, locate study areas and service points, and check its exhibits or collections information for a calm afternoon destination.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library and a map-listed destination for study and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The university campus map lists Collins Memorial Library, and the art department says the library displays book-themed art exhibits and collections.
cards.source_title: Art at Puget Sound | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current access information before planning study time.

cards.title: See the current Kittredge show
cards.subtitle: Kittredge Hall
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page first, then visit during posted gallery hours and spend time with the current student, regional, or visiting-artist work.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with rotating exhibitions and artist talks.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound states that Kittredge Gallery exhibitions and artist talks are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Art at Puget Sound | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: The gallery lists regular hours Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday noon–5 p.m.; confirm the exhibition schedule.

cards.title: Look for a Museum of Natural History event
cards.subtitle: University of Puget Sound campus
cards.notes: Review the museum’s exhibits and event listings, then choose a currently scheduled public program that fits your weekend and registration needs.
cards.short_summary: A campus natural-history collection with exhibits and recurring public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s museum page lists exhibits and describes Night at the Museum as free, family-friendly, and drop-in during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Museum Events | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Event availability varies; verify the current listing, date, and any registration requirement.

cards.title: Pause at Kilworth Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus chapel and event space
cards.notes: Visit only when the building is open or you are attending a scheduled program; take in the chapel’s public-event role and inclusive purpose.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel used for musical, spiritual, academic, and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says Kilworth Chapel hosts musical performances, classes, plays, lectures, spiritual services, and events for people of any, all, or no religion.
cards.source_title: Kilworth Memorial Chapel | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Building availability depends on reservations and scheduled use; do not assume walk-in access.

cards.title: Check recreation options
cards.subtitle: Athletics and Aquatics Center
cards.notes: Bring your current university ID, review the facility schedule, and choose an available recreation activity without interrupting classes, teams, or reserved events.
cards.short_summary: A student-access recreation facility with fitness and aquatics amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound’s recreation policy lists the Athletics & Aquatics Center, fitness center, tennis pavilion, and swimming pool, with student access using a current university ID.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities Use | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: A valid current university ID is required; schedules and priority use can limit recreation access.

cards.title: Choose a Schneebeck concert
cards.subtitle: School of Music performance venue
cards.notes: Browse the current concert calendar, reserve any required ticket, and arrive for an evening performance in the School of Music’s named concert hall.
cards.short_summary: A campus concert venue hosting the Jacobsen Concert Series and other performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says Jacobsen Series concerts use general seating in Schneebeck Concert Hall at 7:30 p.m. unless otherwise indicated.
cards.source_title: Jacobsen Concert Series | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Current Puget Sound students receive free admission but must obtain a complimentary ticket and show student ID; verify the selected event.

cards.title: End with a Norton Clapp Theatre performance
cards.subtitle: Jones Hall
cards.notes: Look at the current production calendar, select an all-ages performance, and confirm the ticket terms and door time before making it your evening plan.
cards.short_summary: A 250-seat campus theatre for the university’s production schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound identifies Norton Clapp Theatre as its 250-seat performance venue in Jones Hall and says the production schedule is posted and updated regularly.
cards.source_title: About Norton Clapp Theatre | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Ticket prices and performance times vary by production; consult the current production listing before attending.
